points.description: States the correct number of values, 4, with the solutions x = 0, π/7, 2π/5, 3π/7 (equivalent exact forms or working that reaches these values earn the mark). Working must be mathematically valid throughout, so a wrong step or wrong final count earns no mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark requires the correct count of 4 reached through valid working. Because the total is 1 mark and the model answer makes the mark conditional on every step being valid, there is no partial credit. Equivalent forms of the solutions and alternative valid methods are accepted.
